basic.name: Roaring Thunderclap
basic.description_template: Deals Lightning DMG equal to {{scaling1}}% of Serval's ATK to a single enemy.

skill.name: Lightning Flash
skill.description_template: Deals Lightning DMG equal to {{scaling1}}% of Serval's ATK to a single enemy and Lightning DMG equal to {{scaling2}}% of Serval's ATK to enemies adjacent to it, with a 80% base chance for enemies hit to become Shocked for 2 turn(s). While Shocked, enemies take Lightning DoT equal to {{scaling3}}% of Serval's ATK at the beginning of each turn.

ultimate.name: Here Comes the Mechanical Fever
ultimate.description_template: Deals Lightning DMG equal to {{scaling1}}% of Serval's ATK to all enemies. Enemies already Shocked will extend the duration of their Shock state by 2 turn(s).

talent.name: Galvanic Chords
talent.description_template: After Serval attacks, deals Lightning Additional DMG equal to {{scaling1}}% of Serval's ATK to all Shocked enemies.

technique.name: Good Night, Belobog
technique.description: Immediately attacks the enemy. After entering battle, deals Lightning DMG equal to 50% of Serval's ATK to a random enemy, with a 100% base chance for all enemies to become Shocked for 3 turn(s). While Shocked, enemies will take Lightning DoT equal to 50% of Serval's ATK at the beginning of each turn.

2.name: Rock 'n' Roll
2.description: Skill has a 20% increased base chance to Shock enemies.

4.name: String Vibration
4.description: At the start of the battle, immediately regenerates 15 Energy.

6.name: Mania
6.description: Upon defeating an enemy, ATK is increased by 20% for 2 turn(s).

eidolons.name: Echo Chamber
eidolons.description: Basic ATK deals Lightning DMG equal to 60% of Basic ATK DMG to a random target adjacent to the target enemy.

eidolons.name: Encore!
eidolons.description: Every time Serval's Talent is triggered to deal Additional DMG, she regenerates 4 Energy.

eidolons.name: Listen, the Heartbeat of the Gears
eidolons.description: Skill Lv. +2, up to a maximum of Lv. 15. Basic ATK Lv. +1, up to a maximum of Lv. 10.

eidolons.name: Make Some Noise!
eidolons.description: Ultimate has a 100% base chance to apply Shock to any enemies not currently Shocked. This Shock has the same effects as the one applied by Skill.

eidolons.name: Belobog's Loudest Roar!
eidolons.description: Ultimate Lv. +2, up to a maximum of Lv. 15. Talent Lv. +2, up to a maximum of Lv. 15.

eidolons.name: This Song Rocks to Heaven!
eidolons.description: Serval deals 30% more DMG to Shocked enemies.
